7. LEAN FORMALIZATION AND VERIFICATION SCOPE
The two source manuscripts [ 5, 6] identify separate proof files: Erdos14_PartI.lean for part I and
Erdos14_PartII_Counterexample.lean for the negative answer to part II. Copies with these names
were available when preparing this unified version. Their shared core proof bodies are identical. Each
includes its helper lemmas in the namespace Erdos14Verification; neither file is a standalone Lean
project. The task wrapper is expected to supply the imports of the Erdős 14 source and TaskSupport,
together with the enclosing namespace Bounty.
The final declarations in the two files have the respective target types
theorem target :
fcTypeOfName% "Erdos14.erdos_14.parts.i"
and
theorem target :
Not (fcTypeOfName% "Erdos14.erdos_14.parts.ii")
The second file writes Not with Lean’s usual negation symbol. For the affirmative-answer target de-
scribed in the original verification reports, the first source type expresses True if and only if the asser-
tion in part I holds . The second expresses True if and only if the existence assertion in part II holds .
Accordingly, the part I submission proves its target, and the part II submission proves the negation of
its target. The part II result is the nonexistence statement of Corollary 1.3.
Table 1 records the correspondence between the mathematical argument and the principal declara-
tions present in the files. The part I scale selection uses two integer square roots instead of an analytic
fourth root. The part II file follows the direct argument in Remark 6.1.
